verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an in-product agent that can analyze your workspace. It can also run scheduled analytical tasks such as deliverability reports, segment audits and broadcast recaps, and a 'Describe segment' button builds segments from plain-text descriptions. Evidence is thin one-line docs with no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: detailed documentation of what insights and recommendations the agent surfaces, explicit evidence of proactive suggestions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The agent can analyze your workspace
You can set up recurring tasks that the agent runs automatically on a schedule—like deliverability reports, segment audits, and broadcast recaps.
When you go to create a segment, you can click **Describe segment** and the agent will help you build a segment from a plain-text description.
